skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is a research surface owned by other batches; the corrections this reading supports are proposed as commit candidates rather than edited in place.
A transferable lesson from another gene is not a therapeutic hypothesis for WWOX; forging one here would convert a stated transfer limit into a lead.
No small molecule with a SMILES is proposed as an intervention, so there is nothing for the BLOCK-1 ADMET gate to triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate for a later BATCH_COMMIT.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader of a paper cannot audit their own locators.

entries.proposition: The proband, homozygous for both missense alleles, had no WWOX-related neurological disease.
entries.snippet: the cancer patient harboring germline homozygous WWOX P252A and P282A variants did not suffer from WWOX‐related nervous system disease

entries.proposition: Chaperone-mediated autophagy is the authors' speculation, not their finding.
entries.snippet: we speculated that lysosomal degradation of WWOX252A mutant protein occurred through chaperone‐mediated autophagy

entries.proposition: Abundance and function are confounded for P252A and the paper says so.
entries.snippet: likely due to the low abundance of the unstable WWOXP252A mutant

entries.proposition: The authors allow residual function rather than a complete null.
entries.snippet: may have some residual protein function to maintain the development of the neurological system

entries.proposition: No nucleotide-excision-repair assay supports the POLE4 claim.
entries.snippet: the functional relevance of WWOX‐POLE4 interaction in nucleotide excision repair remains to be elucidated

entries.proposition: The paper's own domain schematic places P252A inside the SDR and P282A outside it.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1D, lower panel: a 414-residue protein bar with two diamond 'WW' boxes at ticks 16-49 and 57-90 and a box labelled 'SDR' spanning ticks 125-262; the labelled P252A tick falls inside the SDR box and the labelled P282A tick falls to the right of its 262 boundary.

entries.proposition: Both alleles are common in gnomAD and P282A is called tolerated by two of the paper's own predictors.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] (a table published only as a rendered page in the supplementary document) Supplementary Table 4 'WWOX germline variants detected in the patient': row 1 WWOX NM_016373 c.754C>G P252A, SIFT Deleterious, MutationTaster Disease causing, gnomAD allele frequency 0.0063, Genotype Homo; row 2 WWOX NM_016373 c.844C>G P282A, SIFT Tolerated, MutationTaster 'Polymorphism automatic', gnomAD allele frequency 0.0733, Genotype Homo.
